transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

...My family wanted me to come. They keep saying these bank papers prove nothing was taken from me. But... I know they're hiding my money. 

It's been over a year now. They just use, like, bills and fundraisers and trip plans to cover it all up. So... I just have to keep confronting them. Until they tell the truth.
Do you think someone is stealing from you right now?

Yeah. I mean... I just told you they are. My family... and my friends, too. They're all doing it right now. 

They just keep making up those fake bills and... and the trips, just to hide where it's all going. So... yeah. I know they're taking it.
Are you hearing or seeing anything that others can't, which tells you your family and friends are stealing from you?
No. I don't... I don't hear things. Or see things that aren't there. It's just... I just know what they're doing.
Do you think your belief that your family and friends are stealing from you could be wrong?

No. I'm not wrong. 

I... I already told you about this. They keep saying those bank papers prove they didn't take anything, but they did. I've known for over a year that they're hiding my money. All those bills and fundraisers and trip plans... it's just to cover it up. 

I'm not wrong. I just have to keep confronting them until they finally tell the truth.
Have you ever had any periods of time where you didn't think your family and friends were stealing from you?
No... not since it started. It's just been constant. For about a year and two months now, I guess. Ever since my income dropped... that's when it all started. It hasn't stopped since then.
Do you think there's anything else going on with your family and friends besides them stealing from you?
No. Just... just the money. That's all.
Do you think there's anything else that's not true that people are trying to convince you of?
No... I don't think so. Just what I already told you.
Do you think people are out to harm you in any way besides stealing your money?
No... I mean, no. Nobody's trying to hurt me. It's just... they just want my money. That's all.
Have you noticed any changes in your mood over the past year?
No... not really. I just feel normal, I guess. Nothing's changed with that.
Is your belief that your family and friends are stealing from you part of a larger plan or scheme that you've figured out?
No... I don't think so. It's just... they're taking my money. That's it.
Do you think there's anything else that's not true about your life that people are trying to convince you of?

Just... the bank papers. My family and friends keep saying the papers prove nothing was taken. But it's not true. 

I've known for over a year that they're hiding my money. They just... they use things like bills, or fundraisers, or trip plans to cover it up. I just have to keep confronting them until they tell the truth. That's... that's why I came in, really. Because they won't stop lying about it.
Do you believe in anything else that most people would find hard to believe or think is not true?
No... I don't really know what you mean by that. It's just... just what I told you. About them taking my money. There's nothing else.
Do you think there's anything else that's going on with you or your life that you're the only one who knows about?
No... I don't know what else there would be. Just... just what I already told you. That's it.
Do you think there are other people who are also being stolen from in a similar way?
I don't know. I... I haven't really asked anyone else. I just know about my money.
Do you think your family and friends stealing from you is connected to anything else that's happening in your life?
No... I don't think so. It's just the money. I don't see how it would be connected to anything else.
Do you have any other beliefs that you're convinced are true, but others around you disagree with?
No... I don't have anything like that. Just... just what I said before. About them taking from me. That's all.
Do you think there are other things that are being hidden from you besides your money?
I... no. Just my money. I don't know what else they would hide. I haven't noticed anything else.
Do you think there are other things that your family and friends are lying to you about besides the money?
No... I don't think they're lying about anything else. It's... it's just the money. That's the only thing I've noticed.
Do you think there are other people who are out to get you or hurt you in some way?
No... nobody else. Just them. I don't... I haven't seen anyone else trying to do anything. Just the ones taking my money.
